aboutText: iAnalyze is the AI & Data Science Club under iTeam at Al-Zaytoonah University of Jordan. The Academy brings our learning experience into one welcoming space.
proposedCopy: Proposed mission and vision copy · Owner approval pending
mission: Help students take confident first steps in AI and data science through practical, accessible learning and collaboration.
vision: A student community that asks better questions, learns openly and uses data thoughtfully.
parentText: A focused learning community within the wider iTeam student organization. Our identity celebrates both the club and the organization behind it.
values: Questions are welcome, especially the first ones.
Explain the idea. Show the evidence. Keep learning approachable.
Build understanding by helping one another.
Respect people, their work and their data.
historyPending: Verified past activities and achievements have not yet been supplied.
syllabusTitle: Your path from zero to insights.
syllabusText: Six teaching weeks that take you from the essentials of Python to your first exploratory data analysis project.
objectives: Use Google Colab and write simple Python code.
Read datasets and understand their contents with Pandas.
Recognize common data quality problems and handle them thoughtfully.
Find patterns and answer simple questions with data.
Communicate findings through charts and a small practical project.
modules: Get started with Google Colab, variables, basic operations and approachable examples.
Work with groups of values, simple conditions and loops to solve everyday problems.
Open your first dataset, understand rows and columns, and explore the information in a data file.
Spot missing values, duplicates and common errors, and understand why cleaning matters.
Turn numbers into meaningful information using simple statistics and visualizations.
Apply your learning to a simple dataset in a team, then share your main findings.
Optional time for catch-up, revision or an additional activity according to program needs.
prereqText: No previous Python experience is required. A laptop and Google account are recommended for hands-on practice. No complex software installation is needed.
instructionLang: Teaching in Arabic, with English technical terminology.
methodText: A simple explanation, guided practice, a short activity and review. Student submissions and feedback are planned for the future platform.
projectTitle: A small project. Your own insights.
projectText: In Week 06, work with a team to open and understand a simple dataset, perform a basic analysis, create charts and share findings. Submission and assessment requirements will be announced before the project starts.
